_what: Pose comparison on the depth-test recordings (experiment 5's data): AprilGrid (the tag poses, also the reference) against COLMAP and ICP on FoundationStereo and tuned-SGBM depth, one mode each. The markerless methods never see the tags (masked). Scored on frames posed, ATE, RPE, runtime and grip. Experiment 4's config.json compares the ICP modes on S30.

recordings.name: ice_pyramid_shade_pyr1_pass4
recordings.title: Ice, shade
recordings._frame_step: Every frame: the ice passes move faster (tag poses: median 6.6 mm, p95 11.2 mm, max 22.2 mm per frame).
recordings._icp_argv: ICP's lost-frame step limit at ~3x the p95 step: the default 20 mm is below this pass's largest real step.

recordings.name: ice_pyramid_sun_py2_pass1
recordings.title: Ice, sun
recordings._tags: Backlit: tag_poses.py finds no tag in both cameras in any of the 280 frames, so AprilGrid poses nothing, there is no reference (no ATE/RPE) and nothing to mask.
recordings._icp_argv: Same trolley and pass as the shade recording, which has the tags to measure it.

recordings.name: 3DPrintFinal_s30
recordings.title: S30 (lab)
recordings._frame_step: Every 5th as in experiment 4 (tag poses: median 2.1, p95 11.1, max 16.2 mm per kept frame); experiment 5's every 25th is ~23 mm a frame, too far apart for ICP.

reference._why: tag_poses.py at its defaults; its poses are the reference the others are scored against.
reference.label: AprilGrid
reference.mode: tag_poses.py: AprilTag 36h11 corners (sub-pixel) triangulated in stereo, max reprojection 0.8 px; one tag layout fitted to all frames, each frame a rigid fit of the layout. Sees the tags (the only method that does). Grip: tag corners triangulated in the frame.

tag_masks._why: Hide the tags (and their white surround) from every markerless estimator: ice has no tags.

foundationstereo._why: The fs_s05 settings, as in experiments 4 and 5.

_estimators: One mode each. ICP: frame-to-local-map, point-to-plane, chosen in experiment 4 on S30 (map beat frame-to-frame: ATE 2.9 vs 4.4 mm on FS, 5.2 vs 10.1 mm on SGBM; coloured ICP matched point-to-plane at ~3x the time).

estimators.name: colmap
estimators.label: COLMAP
estimators.mode: colmap_poses.py: incremental SfM on SIFT (GPU), intrinsics and stereo rig fixed from the calibration, sequential matching of 12 frames either side, SIFT kept off the masked tags. Grip: SIFT keypoints the final model triangulated (left image).

estimators.name: icp_fs
estimators.label: ICP, FoundationStereo
estimators.mode: depth_frames.py with FoundationStereo (ViT-L, net scale 0.5, 32 iterations, left-right check 3 px), tags masked; icp_poses.py frame-to-local-map (10 frames), point-to-plane, voxels 4 then 2 mm, search 2.5 voxels, 30 iterations, translation-only constant-velocity guess; lost if fitness < 0.3 or step > max-step / 5 deg. Grip: 2 mm depth points whose normal resists a slide along the track (|n . d| > 0.5).

estimators.name: icp_sgbm
estimators.label: ICP, SGBM (tuned)
estimators.mode: depth_frames.py with tuned SGBM (block 11, uniqueness 0, P1/P2 16/32, half resolution), tags masked; ICP exactly as for FoundationStereo. Grip: as for FoundationStereo.

evaluation._why: Drift is measured over windows of this much reference travel.

detections._why: Where each method gets its grip: images for frames spread along each pass, and the grip per frame over every frame for the table.
